tools.name: intent_publish_intent
tools.description: Use this when the user asks LivinIsto to keep watching Slovak property listings (flats, houses, cottages, plots; for sale or rent) for them over time (e.g. "let me know until March about a 2-room flat in Žilina under 150 000 €"). This does NOT start watching by itself and takes no e-mail address or

tools.name: intent_get_intent
tools.description: Use this to check whether an intent created with intent_publish_intent is already confirmed by the user and active, waiting, expired or withdrawn. Requires the intentCode; returns the statement and dates only — never the user's e-mail, the hidden limit or any other personal data.

tools.name: intent_list_matches
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what LivinIsto has found for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. These are the same properties LivinIsto e-mails to the user; this server cannot send messages into the conversation by itself. Requires the intentCode; optional since (ISO time) returns only newer

tools.name: intent_withdraw_intent
tools.description: Use this when the user wants LivinIsto to stop watching for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. Takes effect immediately; nothing more is e-mailed for it. Requires the intentCode.

tools.name: intent_search_offers
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a flat, house, cottage or plot for sale or rent in Slovakia now. Pass what they are looking for as one short phrase (Slovak works best), e.g. "2-izbový byt Bratislava do 200000 €". Returns up to 20 properties from LivinIsto's offer in LivinIsto's own order, each

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "zamery" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: intent_list_matches · Private data: intent_search_offers · Public sink: intent_publish_intent, intent_list_matches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: intent_list_matches · Private data: intent_search_offers · Public sink: intent_publish_intent, intent_list_matches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
